description: Create a brand-new blank Convexity model at an absolute .db path (must not already exist) and make it the active model. Sets the time axis (naive-UTC timestamps) and seeds the default carrier set. Use this when the user wants to build a model from scratch — no need to ask them to create a file in the app first.

path.description: Absolute path for the new .db. Default: ~/models/<name>.db, the folder the Convexity app shows.

name: create_model
